Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically analyzed the caveolar fraction of hLECs treated with recombinant AIBP versus control. While the broader study includes genetic perturbations (Aibp2 KO, Cav-1 KO) and other chemical treatments (MβCD, Atorvastatin), the MS data described in the 'Caveolar fraction isolation and protein extraction' and 'LC-MS/MS analysis' sections specifically pertains to the AIBP treatment of hLECs. Mapping is kept at the parent level (chemical_or_drug) as AIBP is a secreted protein acting as a ligand/agent, but the ontology's fine-grained classes for 'chemical_or_drug' primarily focus on inhibitors, degraders, or toxins.
